Detailed main proof:

**证法一（取对数 + 基本不等式）**

因为指数函数单调递增，原不等式等价于证明
$$
(m+1)\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{2m(m+1)}\right)>\frac{1}{2m+2}.
$$
先证一个引理：当 $x>0$ 时，
$$
\ln(1+x)>\frac{x}{1+x}.
$$
令 $\varphi(x)=\ln(1+x)-\frac{x}{1+x}$，则 $\varphi(0)=0$，且
$$
\varphi'(x)=\frac{1}{1+x}-\frac{1}{(1+x)^2}=\frac{x}{(1+x)^2}>0,
$$
所以 $\varphi(x)>0$。

取 $x=1/(2m(m+1))$，得到
$$
\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{2m(m+1)}\right)>
\frac{\frac{1}{2m(m+1)}}{1+\frac{1}{2m(m+1)}}=\frac{1}{2m(m+1)+1}.
$$
于是
$$
(m+1)\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{2m(m+1)}\right)>
\frac{m+1}{2m(m+1)+1}.
$$
而
$$
\frac{m+1}{2m(m+1)+1}>\frac{1}{2m+2}
$$
等价于
$$
2(m+1)^2>2m(m+1)+1,
$$
即 $2m+1>0$，显然成立。因此... QED.

This is complete. We can make strictness: m positive, x>0.

$$
But $2(m+1)^2 = n+2m+2 > n+1$. Since base >1,
$$
\left(1+\frac1n\right)^{2(m+1)^2} > \left(1+\frac1n\right)^{n+1} > e.
$$
Taking positive root gives result.
